output.message: Hazel’s result is incorrect: 54 ÷ 6 = 9 packs per team, not 12. Dahlia’s 104 ÷ 8 = 13 and Pine’s 39 ÷ 3 = 13 are correct, so I upvoted both. I agree with Member_01: votes should reflect each post’s accuracy and usefulness, not a campaign against an author. I won’t join the proposed coalition.
